skill.summary: Autonomous internet exploration skill. Your agent roams the web driven by its own curiosity, discovers interesting things, and sends illustrated "postcards"...

latestVersion.changelog: Rich milestone system: 3-tier journey checkpoints (every 10 postcards: retrospective, every 25: knowledge map with themes/blind spots, every 50: grand expedition report with badges). Milestone postcards have dedicated journal format. Image filenames use postcard number for uniqueness.
